name: Rumboozle (cup)

Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 95, Adventurer's Armory pg. 19

Category Food/Drink
Description
A potent drink featuring rum, wine, ale, eggs, sugar, and spices, rumboozle is served warm in finer taverns.
